verdict.rationale: Video translation with voice and lip sync carried over is a fair question for an AI video platform, so the axis applies. The evidence covers native audio co-generation, voice control and persistent character voice across shots, but none of it describes translating an existing finished video into other languages or re-syncing lips to translated speech. Those are adjacent generation features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can translate a finished video into other languages with the voice and lip sync carried over
